degree_rationale: Names of the great garments and what they truly signify — Jesuses (Pillar's body and powers), pearls/clusters, icons/tunics (three garments of Living Spirit on his body), elements (Living Power gathering up in lands), Cross of Light, Counsel of Living, afflicted soul. Treats the natural manifest forms of cosmic powers.
direction_rationale: Originating natural-naming — what the visible cosmic 'garments' actually are at their root. Foundation of the natural manifestation of cosmic substance.
grand_man_function: Natural cosmic-garment naming — the foundational identification of what shines forth.
title: The names of the garments and what they truly signify
